title: TradeRoll
description: Reroll villager trades without losing their profession.
body:
# TradeRoll

> Reroll villager trades without losing their profession.

## What it does

Look at a villager, run `/refreshtrades`, and the villager drops back to Novice level with a fresh set of offers — its profession and type stay exactly the same. A 10-second cooldown prevents spam.

No config files. No dependencies beyond Fabric API. Drop the jar in your `mods/` folder and it just works.

## Usage

```
/refreshtrades
```

- Run it while looking directly at a villager (within 5 blocks).
- The villager keeps its **profession** and **type**.
- Trading level resets to **Novice** (level 1).
- Existing offers are **wiped** and a new set is **rolled**.
- 10-second per-player cooldown.

## Compatibility

**Serverside only** — no client install required.

Requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api).

### Supported versions

| Minecraft Version |
|---|
| 26.2 |
| 26.1.x |
| 1.21.7 – 1.21.11 |
| 1.21.4 – 1.21.5 |
| 1.21 – 1.21.1 |
| 1.20.6 |
| 1.20.4 |
| 1.20 – 1.20.2 |
| 1.19.x |
| 1.18.x |
| 1.17.1 |
| 1.16.1 – 1.16.5 |

## Why use it

- Found a villager with the right profession but trash trades? Reroll it.
- Don't want to kill, breed, and wait for a new villager to grow up?
- Running a survival or anarchy server where trade rerolling should be simple?

TradeRoll gives you clean villager management without a full economy overhaul.
